key.category.pingforit.name: Ping For It
settings.pingforit.title: Ping For It Configuration
settings.pingforit.server_settings.valid: Correct the highlighted server value. Inventory values must use their allowed range and multiplier grid.
settings.pingforit.server_settings.confi: Discard unsaved server changes and collapse this section?
settings.pingforit.ping_volume.tooltip:
Ping sound volume.
Decrease: quieter; 0 mutes.
Increase: louder.
settings.pingforit.ping_distance.tooltip:
The farthest distance at which a target can be marked.
Decrease: choose closer targets.
Increase: mark farther targets.
settings.pingforit.item_icon_visible.too:
Item icons on markers.
Off: use the ordinary ping icon.
On: show the item's icon when one is available.
settings.pingforit.direction_indicator_v:
Direction indicators for off-screen markers.
Off: hide them.
On: point toward off-screen markers.
settings.pingforit.mark_transparent_bloc:
Select blocks by their outline shape.
Off: use Minecraft's visible shape.
On: use the outline shape, so decorations can be selected.
settings.pingforit.mark_blacklisted_targ:
Whether blacklisted entities can be selected.
Off: skip blacklisted entities.
On: allow selecting them; spectators stay excluded.
settings.pingforit.mark_fluids.tooltip:
Whether fluids can be selected.
Off: ignore fluids.
On: allow selecting fluids.
settings.pingforit.player_info_mode.tool: Information about who sent the marker.
settings.pingforit.player_info_mode.hold: Show the marker author's name and head while "%s" (%s) is held.
settings.pingforit.player_info_mode.disa: Hide author details; target name and distance stay visible.
settings.pingforit.player_info_mode.alwa:
Keep the author's name and head visible.
Use a separate label below the marker.
settings.pingforit.player_info_mode.comp: Show the author's head beside the distance.
settings.pingforit.team_color_mode.toolt: Team formatting for the author label.
Format the author label with team colors; marker colors still follow Ping Type.
settings.pingforit.team_color_mode.disab: Use the plain author label; marker colors still follow Ping Type.
settings.pingforit.team_color_mode.ping_: Use the plain author label; marker colors still follow Ping Type.
settings.pingforit.team_color_mode.label: Format the author label with team colors; marker colors still follow Ping Type.
settings.pingforit.ping_size.tooltip:
Size of markers and direction indicators.
Decrease: cover less of the view.
Increase: stand out more.
settings.pingforit.wheel_opacity.tooltip:
Wheel background opacity.
Decrease: reveal more of the world; 0 hides the background.
Increase: make the background more opaque.
Option box and label opacity.
Decrease: fade option boxes and text; 0 hides them.
Increase: make option boxes and text more visible.
settings.pingforit.wheel_font_size.toolt:
Text size of wheel options.
Decrease: smaller option text.
Increase: larger option text.
settings.pingforit.wheel_target_font_siz:
Text size of the target name.
Decrease: smaller target text.
Increase: larger target text.
settings.pingforit.reset_all.title: Reset all settings?
settings.pingforit.reset_all.message: Reset every client setting to its default? Server configuration is not reset.
settings.pingforit.wheel_hold_millis.too:
How long to hold before the selector opens.
Decrease: open sooner.
Increase: wait longer before opening.
settings.pingforit.cancel_half_cone_angl:
When canceling, how far a marker can be from where you aim.
Decrease: require more precise aim.
Increase: include markers farther from your aim; the nearest still wins.
settings.pingforit.channel.tooltip:
Channel remembered for this server.
Filled in: exchange pings with players on the same channel.
Empty: use the server's default channel rules.
settings.pingforit.open_block_shape_blac: Save, Close & Open Block Shape Config...

Save and close Settings, then open the client config file.
Changes take effect after restarting the client.
settings.pingforit.logging_profile.toolt:
How much this client writes to the log.
Normal: hides sensitive information.
Detailed: includes sensitive information and more detail.
settings.pingforit.server_logging_profil:
How much the server writes to the log.
Normal: hides sensitive information.
Detailed: includes sensitive information and more detail.
settings.pingforit.entity_block_render_m: How outlines look on entity blocks.
Try every available outline method, including support from other mods. Best chance of a detailed outline.
Use the normal outline for most blocks, including modded ones.
Draw outlines from each block's basic shape. Most reliable, but complex blocks look simpler.
How players without a channel are grouped.
Auto: teammates share a group; players without a team share one group.
Global: all players without a channel share one group.
Team Only: requires a team and groups by team.
Disabled: does not accept pings from players without a channel.
settings.pingforit.player_tracking_enabl:
Whether markers follow the player.
Off: the marker stays where the player was.
On: the marker follows the player.
settings.pingforit.ms_to_regenerate.tool:
How long a used ping takes to become available again.
Decrease: send again sooner; 0 removes the wait.
Increase: wait longer to send again.
settings.pingforit.rate_limit.tooltip:
How many pings each player can send in a row.
Decrease: fewer pings in a row; 0 removes the limit.
Increase: more pings in a row.
settings.pingforit.sync_duration.tooltip:
How long the server keeps a newly created marker.
Decrease: new markers expire sooner.
Increase: new markers stay longer.
command.pingforit.channel.set.descriptio: set your channel, use "" for default channel
command.pingforit.channel.set.reject: Channel names are limited to a length of %s characters
settings.pingforit.long_press_compatibil:
Treat closely spaced clicks as one long press.
Off: use ordinary presses.
On: clicks close together can act as a hold; the gesture shortcut and Danger angle are cleared.

Largest gap between clicks in compatibility mode, at most half the hold time.
Decrease: clicks must be closer together.
Increase: allow a wider gap.
settings.pingforit.marker_display_durati:
How long newly received markers stay visible; 0 uses each marker's server duration.
Decrease: disappear sooner.
Increase: stay visible longer.
settings.pingforit.configuration_notice_:
Size of the notices shown when you toggle target selection.
Decrease: smaller notices; 0 hides them while toggles still work.
Increase: larger notices.
settings.pingforit.server_status.permiss: You do not have permission to edit server settings.
settings.pingforit.server_status.ready: Server settings loaded. Changes are sent when you leave Settings.
settings.pingforit.server_status.draft: Unsaved server changes are retained across categories.
settings.pingforit.server_status.read_on: Server settings are read-only for you. The current values are shown.
settings.pingforit.reset_all.server_draf: This also discards the unsaved server-settings draft.
settings.pingforit.open_client_config.to:
Save and close Settings, then open the client config file.
Changes take effect after restarting the client.
settings.pingforit.presentation.whitelis:
How fields missing from both lists are treated.
Off: use each field's default setting.
On: only allow fields matched by the white list.
settings.pingforit.presentation.server.c: You can edit the server policy
You cannot edit the server policy
settings.pingforit.presentation.feedback: Invalid selector: use namespace:path with * wildcards
That selector is already in the list
The list is full (128 selectors maximum)
That selector is no longer in the list
You do not have permission to edit the server policy
The server did not answer; refresh and try again
settings.pingforit.presentation.fields.e: No fields are available on this connection.
settings.pingforit.presentation.fields.u: Fields are unknown until the server accepts the connection.
settings.pingforit.presentation.fields.n: Configuring a field does not guarantee data: target type, timing, and permission still apply.
settings.pingforit.presentation.rule.all:
Toggle this field in the selected type's white list.
Off: remove this rule; wildcard rules can still allow the field.
On: allow this field ahead of block rules.
settings.pingforit.presentation.rule.blo:
Toggle this field in the selected type's black list.
Off: remove this rule.
On: block this field; matching allow rules still win.
settings.pingforit.presentation.field.mi: Current health of a living entity.
Maximum health of a living entity.
Which item the dropped item is.
How many items are in the dropped stack.
Whether an item icon is available.
State of the block, such as facing or on/off.
settings.pingforit.presentation.field.cr: Rotation speed of the kinetic block.
Whether the kinetic block is connected to a network.
Whether the kinetic network is overstressed.
Stress currently used by the kinetic network.
Total stress the kinetic network can handle.
Stress left in the kinetic network; may be negative when overstressed.
Summary of a Create inventory's contents.
Summary of a Create fluid tank's contents.
settings.pingforit.spatial_selector.gest:
Hold Ping and move to open the menu before the usual hold ends; compatibility mode turns this off.
Off: open with the normal hold.
On: after the minimum hold, move to open early.

How long to hold Ping before moving can open the menu early.
Decrease: qualify sooner.
Increase: hold longer before moving.
settings.pingforit.spatial_selector.dead:
Center area where moving cancels, and how far to move sideways in the inventory list.
Decrease: smaller cancel center; side movement triggers sooner.
Increase: larger cancel center; side movement needs more distance.
settings.pingforit.spatial_selector.stro:
How far to move to enter a submenu or move sideways through the inventory list.
Decrease: enter or navigate sooner.
Increase: need more movement.
settings.pingforit.spatial_selector.dwel:
How long to rest on an option before its submenu opens.
Decrease: open sooner.
Increase: require a longer pause.
settings.pingforit.spatial_selector.root:
How far root menu choices sit from the center.
Decrease: bring root choices inward.
Increase: spread root choices outward.
settings.pingforit.spatial_selector.subm:
Size of radial submenus, including item menus.
Decrease: more compact submenus.
Increase: more spacing between submenu choices.
settings.pingforit.spatial_selector.inve:
Maximum width of the inventory panel as a share of the screen.
Decrease: use less screen space.
Increase: fit wider contents.

Maximum height of the inventory panel as a share of the screen.
Decrease: use less screen space.
Increase: show more rows.
settings.pingforit.spatial_selector.hove:
Return to the previous menu by hovering Back.
Off: use the normal Back action.
On: hover Back for the set time to return.

How long to hover Back before returning.
Decrease: return sooner.
Increase: require longer hovering.
settings.pingforit.spatial_selector.show:
Show a trail that follows your pointer and the selected option.
Off: hide the trail.
On: show the trail.
settings.pingforit.spatial_selector.redu:
Reduce wheel animations.
Off: use full animations.
On: use calmer animations.
settings.pingforit.spatial_selector.cont:
Choose the Ping Type for an item or property.
Off: send Attention directly.
On: choose the Ping Type before sending.
settings.pingforit.budget_delay_notifica:
Notifies admins when server work stays delayed.
Off: no such notices.
On: receive a chat notice when processing stays delayed.
message.pingforit.budget_delay: [ping for it] Sustained budget delays in %s. Review server performance budgets or blacklists.
settings.pingforit.inventory.physical_sl:
How many inventory slots the server processes each tick.
Decrease: lower performance cost.
Increase: allow more content to be processed.
settings.pingforit.inventory.pending_mem:
Memory available to Preview and Tracking across the server.
Decrease: use less memory.
Increase: hold more container data.
settings.pingforit.inventory.display_byt:
Detail shown for each item.
Decrease: use less data.
Increase: show more item detail.
settings.pingforit.inventory.frame_byte_:
Inventory content sent at once.
Decrease: send less at once.
Increase: send more inventory content at once.
settings.pingforit.inventory.size_adjust: Display size lowered to %s to fit the %s inventory frame.
settings.pingforit.inventory.preview_per:
Wait between Preview batches while processing a large inventory.
Decrease: finish Preview sooner.
Increase: use less server work.
settings.pingforit.inventory.preview_max:
Item variants each player can Preview per round.
Decrease: process fewer variants.
Increase: show more variants.

Inventory slots one player's Preview can process per round.
Decrease: less work per player.
Increase: finish larger inventories sooner.

Inventory slots Preview can process across the server per round.
Decrease: less total Preview work.
Increase: more Previews progress together.

Targets each player can Preview at the same time.
Decrease: use fewer resources.
Increase: browse more targets at once.
settings.pingforit.inventory.preview_cli:
Preview data sent to each player per round.
Decrease: use less traffic.
Increase: send more Preview data.
settings.pingforit.inventory.preview_glo:
Preview data the server can send per round.
Decrease: use less traffic.
Increase: send more Preview data at once.
settings.pingforit.inventory.tracking_di:
Whether each side of a container is tracked separately.
Off: lower server load when contents match.
On: track each face separately.

Whether each player's view is tracked separately.
Off: lower server load when contents match.
On: track each player separately.
settings.pingforit.inventory.tracking_pe:
Wait after a Tracking scan finishes before the next scan.
Decrease: updates arrive sooner.
Increase: use less server work.
settings.pingforit.inventory.tracking_ma:
Item variants one target can track at the same time.
Decrease: use fewer resources.
Increase: track more variants at once.

Inventory slots one target's Tracking can process per round.
Decrease: less work per target.
Increase: scan each target further.

Inventory slots Tracking can process across the server per round.
Decrease: less total Tracking work.
Increase: more targets progress together.
settings.pingforit.inventory.tracking_st:
Changes sent to each player for each target per round.
Decrease: use less update traffic.
Increase: send more changes per round.
settings.pingforit.inventory.tracking_sn:
Content sent when a tracked inventory first appears or is restored, per player and round.
Decrease: use less traffic.
Increase: show or restore content sooner.
settings.pingforit.inventory.tracking_gl:
Tracking data the server can send per round.
Decrease: use less traffic.
Increase: send more Tracking data at once.
settings.pingforit.inventory.tracking_re:
Wait before retrying Tracking after an error; 0 turns this wait off.
Decrease: recover sooner.
Increase: fewer retries.
settings.pingforit.inventory.tracking_he:
How often to check that tracked contents are in sync; 0 turns off these checks.
Decrease: notice out-of-sync contents sooner.
Increase: lower checking cost.
settings.pingforit.inventory.tracking_gr:
How long Tracking traffic can be grouped into a short burst.
Decrease: use smaller bursts.
Increase: allow more updates in short bursts.
settings.pingforit.spatial_selector.prec:
How often Precise looks for targets.
Decrease: update sooner; 1 checks every tick.
Increase: update less often.
settings.pingforit.spatial_selector.trai:
How long the gesture trail can grow.
Decrease: draw a shorter trail.
Increase: draw a longer trail.

How visible the gesture trail is.
Decrease: fainter trail; 0 hides it.
Increase: more visible trail.
settings.pingforit.double_click_danger_w:
Longest gap between clicks for a repeated Danger ping.
Decrease: click faster.
Increase: allow slower clicks.
settings.pingforit.double_click_danger_a:
How far the mouse can turn between clicks in repeated Danger; 0 turns the gesture off.
Decrease: keep aim steadier.
Increase: allow more mouse turn.
settings.pingforit.spatial_selector.inve:
Release behavior for the inventory list and item menu.
Off: releasing submits or closes as usual.
On: the first release keeps it open; later taps submit, holding cancels the selection.
settings.pingforit.scope.server.tooltip: View server settings; editing requires permission level 3.
settings.pingforit.navigation.done.toolt: Save client settings, send server changes, and close.
settings.pingforit.presentation.server.t: Field rules for the selected target type; editing requires permission level 3.
settings.pingforit.presentation.target_t: Choose which target type's rules to view and edit.
settings.pingforit.presentation.selector:
Field-ID selector, such as minecraft:entity.health or create:kinetic.*.
* matches only within one namespace or path part and never crosses :.
Use Add to apply the selector.
settings.pingforit.presentation.add.tool: Add the entered selector to the current list.
settings.pingforit.presentation.remove.t: Remove this selector from the current list.
Read the latest rules from the server again.
settings.pingforit.category.client.displ: Set how markers look and how far you can mark.
settings.pingforit.category.client.selec: Choose which targets can be pinged.
settings.pingforit.category.client.chann: Configure the channel and local notices.
settings.pingforit.category.client.geome: Choose how block outlines look and open the client config file.
settings.pingforit.category.client.perfo: Set how often Precise looks for targets.
settings.pingforit.category.server.chann: Configure server channel and player behavior.
settings.pingforit.category.server.send_: Configure the server's marker send rate.
settings.pingforit.category.server.perfo: Adjust server performance monitoring and inventory processing.
settings.pingforit.category.server.serve: Configure field rules per target type.
monitor.pingforit.format.label: %1$s · %2$s
monitor.pingforit.tooltip.summary: Aggregates the selected detail values; it does not add another measurement site.
monitor.pingforit.tooltip.timing: Elapsed time over the sample window. Parent and child phases are inclusive and must not be added; a saturated total or count is a lower bound.
monitor.pingforit.tooltip.timing_max: Peak elapsed time over the sample window.
monitor.pingforit.tooltip.counter: Event count over the sample window, not a current queue size. A saturated count is a lower bound.
monitor.pingforit.tooltip.gauge: Latest observed value. A missing reading means unknown, not zero.
monitor.pingforit.tooltip.budget: One independent budget ledger. Different budgets are not convertible, and remaining can be negative after a live cap reduction.
monitor.pingforit.tooltip.memory: Accounted retained memory, not JVM heap, allocation rate, or transport bytes.
monitor.pingforit.tooltip.scope.local: Local values use the client clock and are never merged with server timing.
monitor.pingforit.tooltip.scope.server: Server values are shown only to a viewer permitted to receive numeric telemetry.
monitor.pingforit.tooltip.scope.shared: Shared values are counted once and are never attributed to Preview or Tracking.
monitor.pingforit.tooltip.scope.summary: This aggregate has no single scope; its selected values keep their own sources.
monitor.pingforit.tooltip.sync: Sync counters describe regular inventory-v2 traffic only, not all connection traffic or the CREATED creation receipt.
settings.pingforit.monitor.hud_enabled.t:
Show performance information on screen.
Off: hide it; your metric choices stay.
On: show the chosen metrics.
settings.pingforit.monitor.preview_enabl:
Performance information about server inventory previews.
Off: do not record it.
On: record it.
settings.pingforit.monitor.tracking_enab:
Performance information about server inventory tracking.
Off: do not record it.
On: record it.
settings.pingforit.monitor.metric.toolti:
Choose what the monitor shows.
Your choices stay when the monitor is off.
monitor.pingforit.status.dependency_off: Preview and Tracking off; shared unavailable
monitor.pingforit.tooltip.buffer_estimat: Client-local estimate of retained buffer bytes, not measured transport bytes or JVM heap. An omitted estimate is unavailable, not zero.
monitor.pingforit.tooltip.handoff: Observed handoff counts regular inventory-v2 frames and bytes passed to the transport boundary, not delivery acknowledgements or compressed connection traffic. Unobserved handoff frames and candidate bytes stay separate; candidate bytes are not added as sent bytes.
